facts.fact: Decree 2023-113 of 7 September 2023 (Journal Officiel no. 1543, 15 October 2023) states that the Office National de Normalisation et de Métrologie was instituted by decree 2023-080 of 9 May 2023, and gives it the secretariat of the new national standardisation council and the accreditation cell; the document names no national standard on information technology or data.
facts.system: Office National de Normalisation et de Métrologie

facts.fact: Decree 2023-113 of 7 September 2023 creates the Conseil National de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité, an advisory body under the industry minister, under articles 2 and 15 of law 2010-003 of 14 January 2010 on standardisation and quality promotion.
facts.system: Conseil National de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité

systems.system: Office National de Normalisation et de Métrologie
systems.country_label: Office National de Normalisation et de Métrologie
systems.owner: Ministry of Commerce, Industry, Handicrafts and Tourism (industry minister has tutelage over the council and committee)

systems.system: Conseil National de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité
systems.country_label: Conseil National de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité

note: No certification fact: the decree sets accreditation of conformity assessment bodies (ISO/IEC 17011) via the Office's accreditation cell, which is not certification against an IT or data standard and names no certifier; the accreditation committee is class other.
